newsitem.title: UK: MFI sales rise slower than first half.
newsitem.headline: MFI sales rise slower than first half.

text.p: UK furniture stores company MFI Furniture Group Plc said on Tuesday that sales for the first 16 weeks of its second half, including the winter sales period, were 7.3 percent ahead of the same time last year.
The company said the sales rise was lower than that achieved in the first half and "reflects the fact that our market place has not yet seen a sustained uplift in demand."
MFI said sales in its UK businesses had grown by 7.8 percent in the second half to date. Sales in the main retail business were 6.5 percent ahead and like-for-like sales increased by 7.1 percent.
It said new MFI Homeworks stores traded well during the winter sale, significantly outperforming the rest of the chain, but sales from old-style MFI stores were lower than last year.
The programme of store conversion is ahead of plan, and MFI anticipates raising the number of MFI Homework stores to 92 by the end of April from 81 currently.

In France, sales for the second half to date rose by 10.8 percent on the previous year in local currency terms, equivalent to a fall of 7.2 percent in sterling terms, with average retail trading area up by 19 percent on last year.
